newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: CA sees gain in Wienerberger results.
newsitem.headline: CA sees gain in Wienerberger results.

text.p: Austrian brick maker Wienerberger Baustoffindustrie will report a substantial improvement in earnings in the current year, majority-owner Creditanstalt-Bankverein said on Wednesday.

"We can assume that there will be a significant gain in earnings at Wienerberger in 1997," Creditanstalt chief executive Guido Schmidt-Chiari told a news conference. He did not specify which specific profit figure he was referring to.
"1996 was a very difficult year for the construction materials industry, and the outlook for 1997 is substantially better," he added.
Creditanstalt effectively controls 32.2 percent of Wienerberger. The bank owns half of Wienerberger Holding, which in turn controls the group's operative units.
Wienerberger in January said preliminary 1996 pretax profit fell to 1.3 billion schillings from 1.5 billion a year earlier on sales of 14.57 billion schillings, up from 12.86 billion.
The group predicted a 25 percent rise in 1997 pretax and a 10 percent gain in sales amid an improved outlook for the construction industry.
